meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 iMessage 接成渠道:复制注册适配器、装依赖、按所选模式(本地读 chat.db 或经 Photon)配置并重启。之后接线即可收发你的 iMessage。
howto.when: 当你说出 "add imessage"、"connect imessage"、"imessage via photon" 等触发词时触发。

say.note: 会复制适配器并询问使用本地还是远程模式。
需要 macOS 并给 Node 授权完全磁盘访问。

say.text: 通过 Photon 接入远程 iMessage
say.note: 要求提供 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API 密钥。

howto.what_en: Claude adds iMessage as a chat channel: copies/registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, configures .env for local macOS (chat.db) or remote Photon mode, restarts, then wire via /init-first-agent to handle your iMessage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add imessage", "connect imessage", or similar commands (e.g. "imessage via photon", "native imessage").

say_en.note: Starts the flow and asks for local or remote mode.

say_en.text: Set up iMessage in local mode.
say_en.note: Needs macOS with Full Disk Access granted to Node.

say_en.text: Set up remote iMessage via Photon.
say_en.note: Asks for your Photon server URL and API key.
